features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Religion if you don't already have it.

features.name: Divine Symbol
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, as an action create a hovering divine symbol within 5 ft of you (Tiny, invulnerable, intangible) for 1 minute. While active:

* Functions as a spellcasting focus for cleric spells.
* As a bonus action, transform into thieves' tools (loses other properties while in this form; revert as bonus action).
* Sheds bright light 10 ft, dim light 10 ft further. Toggle as bonus action (also snuff one nearby nonmagical light source).
* When created and as an action on each turn: make a ranged spell attack vs a creature within 30 ft. Hit: 1d8 radiant or necrotic (your choice). Scales: 2d8 (L5), 3d8 (L11), 4d8 (L17).

payload.name: Divine Symbol
payload.description: Create a hovering divine symbol for 1 min: spellcasting focus, thieves' tools (bonus action toggle), light (10-ft bright/10-ft dim), ranged spell attack 1d8 radiant/necrotic per action (scales to 4d8 at L17).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
When you reach 3rd level, you gain cleric spellcasting. WIS is your spellcasting ability.

**Spell save DC** = 8 + prof + WIS modifier.
**Spell attack modifier** = prof + WIS modifier.

You learn 3 cleric cantrips (another at 10th level). You know 3 1st-level cleric spells (2 must be abjuration or necromancy). See the Soulspy Spellcasting table for slots and spells known progression (up to 4th-level slots at Rogue 19).

features.name: Sacred Stealth
features.description: Starting at 9th level, you can use Sneak Attack on a creature hit by your Divine Symbol attack if the target is within 5 ft of a non-incapacitated ally and you don't have disadvantage. Uses equal to WIS modifier (min 1); regain all on short or long rest.

features.name: Touching the Soul
features.description: When you reach 13th level, use your Divine Symbol to deliver touch-range cleric spells to a creature you can see within 30 ft (can't use Sacred Stealth on delivered spells; symbol ends after). You can also switch between radiant and necrotic damage when casting damage spells.

features.name: Life Thief
features.description: At 17th level, when you deal radiant or necrotic damage with your Divine Symbol or a cleric spell or cantrip, choose a friendly creature within 30 ft you can see (including yourself). That creature regains HP equal to half the radiant or necrotic damage dealt. 1/short or long rest.
